readmeMarkdown:
# LeapSteps for Google Antigravity & Gemini CLI

Connect [LeapSteps](https://leapsteps.ai) to your AI coding agent via the official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (`https://leapsteps.ai/mcp`) to plan your day, manage tasks and subtasks, advance goal steps, run your focus timer, and prepare schedule proposals.

## Capabilities

- **Plan & Tasks**: Read Today, Upcoming, Someday, and custom lists; search tasks; add, reschedule, edit, comment on, and complete tasks and subtasks; mark tasks with `AI working`.
- **Goals**: Read your goals, steps, and progress; rewrite mid-term or short-term steps and notes; finish a step and set the next one; add a goal's short-term step to your Plan.
- **Focus Timer (Do)**: Check the active timer and start, pause, resume, or stop Pomo, Focus, or Multitask sessions.
- **Schedule Planning**: Read bounded scheduling context and prepare schedule or planning preference proposals for review in the LeapSteps app.
- **Confirmed Removal**: Request to archive or delete tasks, subject to your explicit confirmation in the app.

## Privacy & Safety Controls

- **In-App Confirmation for Removals**: Archive and delete requests never remove anything automatically. They wait for your confirmation inside the LeapSteps app and expire after 24 hours if unanswered.
- **In-App Approval for Schedules**: Schedule proposals and preference updates are drafts until you review and approve them in LeapSteps.
- **OAuth 2.1 Sign-In**: Connects via secure OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration. You can revoke any connected assistant at any time from **Settings > Connected AI apps** in LeapSteps.

## Prerequisites

- A LeapSteps account created in the LeapSteps app (iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Android, or Windows).
- The latest version of LeapSteps on your device to confirm archive/delete requests, approve schedule proposals, and manage connections.
- Note: LeapSteps is not currently offered in the European Union, the European Economic Area, or the United Kingdom.

## Installation

### Google Antigravity

Install from the Antigravity Marketplace or locally via the CLI:

```bash
agy plugin install leapsteps@antigravity-plugins-partners
```

After installing, open **Customizations > Installed**, select **LeapSteps**, and click **Authenticate** under **MCP Servers** to sign in with your LeapSteps account.

### Gemini CLI

Install directly from GitHub:

```bash
gemini extensions install https://github.com/zestroot/leapsteps-plugin
```

## Example Prompts

- `"What's on my plate today in LeapSteps, and what's overdue?"`
- `"Add a task in LeapSteps to call the dentist tomorrow at 9 AM, high priority."`
- `"What's the next step on my goal in LeapSteps? Add it to my plan for today."`
- `"Start a 25-minute focus session in LeapSteps on my top task."`
